protocol.name: song_guided_arm_imu_calibration_exploratory
protocol.source: Song HDF5 v3 S01-S04, one participant and date, 250 Hz eight-channel EMG plus 112 Hz recorded IMU
protocol.calibration_policy: Only valid completed pre-formal stable intervals. Extract 22-IMU-sample windows every 11 samples. Per-session still/rest reference is median of the two rest blocks; each direction prototype is the median of its guided arm block. Never use formal target labels for calibration.
protocol.arm_descriptor: Existing 13-dimensional F6 real-IMU magnitude and mean-gravity descriptor; subtract per-session rest descriptor. No body-frame or absolute-yaw claim.
protocol.distance: Source S01/S02 calibration-prototype coordinate standard deviation floored at 0.05; squared Euclidean distances; fixed softmax of negative half distance; no target-fitted scale or temperature.
protocol.hand_model: Previously S03-selected F0v2+F2a+F3c; source S01/S02 windows only; balanced LogisticRegression C=1 random_state=20260924; original 28-state runtime
protocol.arm_source_model: Existing F6 descriptor; source S01/S02 formal windows only; balanced LogisticRegression C=1 random_state=20260924
protocol.context_reference: Previous F0v2+IMU joint classifier from SONG_28_RESULTS.json and its saved native-trial probabilities
protocol.score: Mean window probabilities separately for arm and hand per formal trial; outer product and normalize to 28 native states; joint trial macro-F1 is primary, arm and hand accuracies secondary
protocol.selection: This is a fixed paired comparison. Do not tune descriptors, scale or temperature on S03/S04 and do not deploy from same-day results.
protocol.scope: Pre-formal guided cues are an explicit calibration budget. S04 was previously inspected; one person/day and cue-labelled stable windows cannot establish online or cross-donning performance.
